scope: Offline checks of saved data. No new physical test.
methods: Hash each source file and compare the quoted line ranges with that source.
Recalculate packet CRCs independently. Check lengths, offsets and admission values.
Reconstruct all 162 recipe buffers and compare them with the native record.
Check ten command exchanges and three unchanged board photographs.
Compare all native TX/RX bytes with the saved run-89 physical decode.
Replay all 121 share inputs. Compare intermediate hashes, last digests and recorded target decisions.
Compare ten segmented sets. Replay 479 candidate hashes and check the filter decisions.
Check 300 source sets, 475 valid identities and four invalid candidates.
Render all 28 SVG files. Examine labels, layout, units and source values.
Check complete coverage of thirteen packet maps and six bit maps.
Compare all four quoted UART lines with their source records.
Compare each cropped view with its source pixels.
Examine page links, section anchors, asset hashes and the repository test results.
limits: No exhaustive nonce enumeration was repeated.
Private pool replies were not reproduced by a new network test.
Historical raw captures were not all decompressed and decoded again.
No independent editorial review was done.
